stories.title: Consent Data Schema & Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and implement data models and storage schema for two-tier consent, including consent state, timestamps, audit fields, and tier designation. Establish Pydantic contracts and MongoDB document structure to ensure consistent enforcement across services.

stories.title: Consent Framework Testing & Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification behavior, state transitions, and cross-service compliance. Ensure HIPAA Safe Harbor rules are correctly applied and no identifiable data persists without Tier 2 consent.
